# Independent visual evidence checks

Resolve the installed `territory-map-card-builder` by frontmatter name and read its `references/visual-evidence-integrity.md`. Apply that shared evidence procedure independently to the exact candidate and saved PDF; it supplements the existing gates without changing their thresholds.

- Verify the common sidebar palette: yellow `#FFDC18`, green `#51C72B`, red `#FF1435`, in the approved caption order. Run the builder's standalone `scripts/check_shared_legend.py` on the actual PDF and inspect the sidebar yourself. Preserve source street colors independently; a source-map palette is not a sidebar palette.
- Establish entrance corridors/junctions from the source before examining arrow placement. Check the prior radius/region declaration, transform and raw overlap result. Reject a radius or region expanded after measuring to conceal an unrelated crossing or a shaft along road ink. A declared small source-junction region can include its serving public-road contact; arbitrary adjacent-road contact cannot. Do not impose 7 px as a universal rule or accept 8 px merely because it clears a failure.
- Independently measure a complete original and final stroke cross-section when a clipped wide-stroke sample is disputed. Preserve the narrow diagnostics and original edit masks. Require unchanged-limit style results, exact native/expected paint, zero outside those masks and paired visual agreement. A sampling explanation on one card does not waive a real mismatch on another.
- Inspect whole street names, prefixes and suffixes. A word that looks broken or twists its final letters around a guide bend fails even when glyph gaps pass. Require relocation of the complete label to a suitable run on the same street, without arbitrary angle thresholds, stretched tracking, shrunk text or changed road geometry. Check inset/frame clipping too.

Bind every supplemental report to the exact PDF hash and identify who actually inspected each screenshot. A technical rerun may cite a separate independent visual receipt; its author must not claim another reviewer's screenshots as personally inspected. An unverified required check or visible defect blocks release and caps the score at 8; aim for 10, with the existing minimum of 9 unchanged.

For dark neutral/black callout heads and mutated shared native Forms, apply the A51 self-occlusion and stale-index regressions in learning-regressions.md. Exclude validated annotation shapes from both road-visibility comparisons while retaining opaque nonannotation overpaint, and bind target paths only after reopening actual serialized final bytes. Preserve real gap/crossing negatives and every existing threshold.
